execution_model.description: Candidates write a complete executable program. The platform supplies test-case input through standard input and compares standard output with the expected output.

problems.title: Range Sum Queries
problems.description:
You are given an integer array and Q queries. Each query asks for the sum of
the elements between two zero-based indices L and R, inclusive. Print one answer
per query. Build your solution so that many queries can be answered efficiently.
problems.input_format: N and Q. The next line contains N integers. Each of the next Q lines contains L R.
problems.output_format: Print Q lines, each containing the requested range sum.

problems.title: Longest Positive-Sum Segment
problems.description:
Given an array, find the maximum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is
strictly greater than zero. The array can contain positive, zero, and negative
values. Print 0 if no such non-empty subarray exists.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum valid length.

problems.title: Equal Sum Split Point
problems.description:
Find every index i such that the sum of elements strictly to the left of i
equals the sum strictly to the right of i. Indices are zero-based. Print all
valid indices in increasing order, or -1 if none exist.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print valid indices separated by spaces, or -1.

problems.title: First Unique Value
problems.description:
Given an integer sequence, print the first value that occurs exactly once.
If every value occurs more than once, print -1.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the first value with frequency one, otherwise -1.

problems.title: Longest Zero-Sum Subarray
problems.description:
Find the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose elements sum to zero.
The array may contain positive and negative values.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum length, or 0 if no such subarray exists.

problems.title: Count Subarrays With Target Sum
problems.description:
Count how many contiguous subarrays have sum exactly K. The array can contain
negative values, so a two-pointer window is not generally valid.
problems.input_format: N and K. The next line contains N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the number of qualifying subarrays.

problems.title: Pair With Target in Sorted Array
problems.description:
A sorted array is given. Determine whether two distinct elements add up to the
target. Print YES and their zero-based indices if found; otherwise print NO.
problems.input_format: N and target. The next line contains N sorted integers.
problems.output_format: Print YES i j for the first pair found with i < j, otherwise NO.

problems.title: Three Values Closest to Target
problems.description:
Choose three distinct array elements whose sum is closest to a target T. Print
the closest sum. If two sums have the same absolute difference, print the smaller
sum.
problems.input_format: N and T. The next line contains N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the closest three-element sum.

problems.title: Container With Maximum Area
problems.description:
Given heights of vertical lines, choose two lines that together with the
horizontal axis form a container. The amount of water is the smaller height
multiplied by the distance between the lines. Print the maximum possible area.
problems.input_format: N followed by N heights.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum area.

problems.title: Maximum Sum of K Consecutive Values
problems.description: Find the maximum sum among all contiguous subarrays of exactly K elements.
problems.input_format: N and K. The next line contains N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum K-element sum.

problems.title: Longest Subarray With At Most K Distinct Values
problems.description:
Find the maximum length of a contiguous subarray containing at most K distinct
values.
problems.input_format: N and K. The next line contains N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum length.

problems.title: Minimum Window Covering Required Values
problems.description:
You are given two lowercase strings S and T. Find the shortest contiguous
substring of S that contains every character of T with at least the required
frequency. If multiple shortest windows exist, return the leftmost one. Print
-1 if no such window exists.
problems.input_format: Two lines containing S and T.
problems.output_format: Print the minimum covering substring, or -1.

problems.title: Find Target Index
problems.description:
Given a sorted array and a target value, find its first occurrence. Print -1
if the target is absent.
problems.input_format: N and target. The next line contains N sorted integers.
problems.output_format: Print the first zero-based index of target, or -1.

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.description:
A strictly increasing array was rotated at an unknown position. Find the
index of target in the resulting array, or -1 if absent.
problems.input_format: N and target. The next line contains the rotated array.
problems.output_format: Print the zero-based index, or -1.

problems.title: Minimum Capacity to Finish Within D Days
problems.description:
Packages must be shipped in their given order. A ship has a fixed capacity and
can carry consecutive packages during one day. Find the minimum capacity needed
to ship all packages within D days.
problems.input_format: N and D. The next line contains N package weights.
problems.output_format: Print the minimum required capacity.

problems.title: Balanced Brackets
problems.description:
Given a string containing only (), {}, and [], determine whether brackets are
properly nested and closed.
problems.input_format: One line containing the bracket string.
problems.output_format: Print YES if valid, otherwise NO.

problems.title: Next Greater Value
problems.description:
For every element in an integer array, find the first element to its right
that is strictly greater. Print -1 if none exists.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print N answers separated by spaces.

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.description:
Given heights of adjacent histogram bars, find the largest rectangular area
that can be formed using one or more consecutive bars.
problems.input_format: N followed by N non-negative heights.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum rectangle area.

problems.title: Reverse a Linked Sequence
problems.input_format: N followed by N node values.
problems.output_format: Print the reversed values separated by spaces.

problems.title: Detect Cycle by Position
problems.description:
Build a singly linked list from N values. The last node points to the node at
zero-based position P, or to no node when P is -1. Determine whether the resulting
linked structure contains a cycle.
problems.input_format: N and P. The next line contains N values. P is -1 or a valid node index.
problems.output_format: Print YES if a cycle exists, otherwise NO.

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.description:
Read two sorted singly linked lists, build both lists, and merge them into one
sorted list by reusing node links. Print the merged values. Duplicate values are
allowed.
problems.input_format: First line N M. Second line has N values. Third line has M values.
problems.output_format: Print the merged sequence in non-decreasing order.

problems.title: Generate Binary Digits
problems.description:
Given N, print all binary strings of length N in lexicographic order. Use
recursive generation; each position may contain 0 or 1.
problems.input_format: One integer N.
problems.output_format: Print one binary string per line.

problems.title: Unique Subsets
problems.description:
Given an array that may contain duplicates, generate every distinct subset.
Print subsets in lexicographic order. Within each subset, values must also appear
in non-decreasing order. Print an empty subset as an empty line.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print one distinct subset per line, values separated by spaces.

problems.title: N-Queens Count
problems.description:
Place N queens on an N x N chessboard so that no two queens attack each other.
Count all valid arrangements. Print the number of solutions. Do not print the
boards.
problems.input_format: One integer N.
problems.output_format: Print the number of valid arrangements.

problems.title: Binary Tree Height
problems.description:
A binary tree is given in level-order. The value -1 represents a missing child.
Build the tree and print its height measured as the number of nodes on the
longest root-to-leaf path. An empty tree has height 0.
problems.input_format: N followed by N level-order tokens; -1 means null.
problems.output_format: Print the height.

problems.title: Level Order Traversal
problems.description:
Build a binary tree from level-order values where -1 represents a missing
child. Print the nodes level by level. Print each level on a separate line.
problems.input_format: N followed by N level-order tokens; -1 means null.
problems.output_format: Print each non-empty level on its own line.

problems.title: Maximum Path Sum in Binary Tree
problems.description:
Given a binary tree in level-order, find the maximum sum of values along any
non-empty path. A path may start and end at any nodes but must follow parent-child
connections and cannot reuse a node.
problems.input_format: N followed by N level-order tokens; -1 means null.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum path sum.

problems.title: K Smallest Values
problems.description:
Given N integers and K, print the K smallest values in non-decreasing order.
Duplicate values should be preserved.
problems.input_format: N and K followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print K values in ascending order.

problems.title: Kth Largest Value
problems.description:
Find the Kth largest value in an unsorted array. Equal values count as separate
positions.
problems.input_format: N and K followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the Kth largest value.

problems.title: Running Median
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print N medians separated by spaces.

problems.title: Minimum Coins for Exact Amount
problems.description:
Given coin denominations and an amount, repeatedly choose the largest coin not
exceeding the remaining amount. Print the number of coins used, or -1 if the
amount cannot be formed using this greedy process.
problems.input_format: N and amount. The next line contains N coin denominations.
problems.output_format: Print the number of selected coins, or -1.

problems.title: Maximum Non-Overlapping Activities
problems.description:
Each activity has a start and finish time. Select the maximum number of
non-overlapping activities. An activity starting exactly when another finishes
is allowed.
problems.input_format: N followed by N lines containing start and finish.
problems.output_format: Print the maximum number of activities selected.

problems.title: Minimum Refuels to Reach Destination
problems.description:
A vehicle starts with a given amount of fuel and must reach a destination at
distance D. There are fuel stations at increasing distances. Each station gives
a fixed amount of fuel. Determine the minimum number of refuels needed. A station
can only be used after reaching its position.
problems.input_format: First line D and initialFuel. Second line N. Next N lines contain position and fuel.
problems.output_format: Print minimum refuels, or -1 if the destination cannot be reached.

problems.title: Count Connected Components
problems.description:
Given an undirected graph with N vertices numbered 1..N and M edges, count
how many connected components it contains.
problems.input_format: N M followed by M lines of undirected edges u v.
problems.output_format: Print the number of connected components.

problems.title: Shortest Unweighted Path
problems.description:
Given an undirected unweighted graph and two vertices S and T, find the minimum
number of edges between them. Print -1 if T cannot be reached from S.
problems.input_format: N M S T followed by M lines containing edges u v.
problems.output_format: Print the shortest distance in edges, or -1.

problems.title: Course Dependency Ordering
problems.description:
There are N tasks and M prerequisite relations. For each relation A B, task A
must be completed before task B. Output one valid ordering of all tasks. If no
valid ordering exists because of a cycle, print IMPOSSIBLE. If multiple orders
are possible, print the lexicographically smallest one.
problems.input_format: N M followed by M lines A B.
problems.output_format: Print the lexicographically smallest topological ordering, or IMPOSSIBLE.

problems.title: Climbing Steps
problems.description:
You can climb either 1 or 2 steps at a time. Given N, count the number of
different ways to reach exactly step N.
problems.input_format: One integer N.
problems.output_format: Print the number of ways.

problems.title: Minimum Coins to Amount
problems.description:
Given coin denominations and a target amount, find the minimum number of coins
needed to form the exact amount. Each denomination may be used unlimited times.
Print -1 when impossible.
problems.input_format: N and amount. The next line contains N coin denominations.
problems.output_format: Print minimum number of coins, or -1.

problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.description:
Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence. The chosen
elements do not need to be contiguous.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integers.
problems.output_format: Print the LIS length.

problems.title: Network Propagation Time
problems.description:
A directed network contains N nodes and M weighted links. A signal starts at
node S and travels along links. Each link has a non-negative travel time. Find
the time required for every node to receive the signal. If any node is unreachable,
print -1; otherwise print the maximum shortest-path distance.
problems.input_format: N M S followed by M lines containing U V W, meaning a directed edge U -> V with weight W.
problems.output_format: Print the time for the last node to receive the signal, or -1 if some node is unreachable.
